# Browser libraries

- `pdf-lib-1.17.1.min.js`: pdf-lib 1.17.1, MIT, upstream `https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib`. Copied unchanged from the installed package distribution; license included.
- `qrcode-1.4.4.min.js`: qrcode 1.4.4, MIT, upstream `https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode`. Same version previously loaded from jsDelivr; distribution and license copied unchanged from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode@1.4.4/`.

Both scripts are served locally alongside the app. No QR token or route data is sent to a PDF/QR generation service. Firebase SDK imports remain unchanged.
